entities.name: Access barring check
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE to determine if an access attempt is allowed or barred based on access identities and barring parameters.

entities.name: UAC barring parameter
entities.description: Contains barring configuration parameters including uac-BarringForAccessIdentity, uac-BarringFactorForAI3, uac-BarringFactor, and uac-BarringTime.

entities.name: Access Identity
entities.description: Identifies the type of access attempt, with specific identities like Access Identity 1 and Access Identity 3 having special barring rules.

entities.name: Access attempt allowed
entities.description: Condition where UE determines the access attempt is permitted to proceed.

entities.name: Access attempt barred
entities.description: Condition where UE determines the access attempt is not permitted and barring procedures apply.

entities.name: Timer T390
entities.description: Timer started when access is barred, with duration calculated from uac-BarringTime parameter.

entities.name: Random number rand
entities.description: Random value drawn uniformly between 0 and 1 used for probabilistic barring decisions.

relations.description: Access barring check procedure uses parameters from UAC barring parameter IE.
Access barring check evaluates based on Access Identity values.
Procedure establishes access allowed condition when barring criteria are not met.
Procedure establishes access barred condition when barring criteria are met.
Access barred condition triggers starting of timer T390.
Procedure uses random number generation for probabilistic barring decisions.
